newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita estimates raised.

text.p: Nomura Securities said in a report it was raising its 1997 earnings estimates for Brazilian steelmaker Acesita to a profit of $0.18 per ADR from a loss of $0.35.
-- said it was raising its 1998 earnings estimate to $0.40 per ADR from $0.26.

-- "We are increasing our earnings estimates for Cia. Acos Especiais Itabira (Acesita) to incorporate significant non-cash items, including change in depreciation methodology and the manner in which accounting is done for subsidiaries," said analyst Steven Assis in the report.
- It also reiterated its neutral rating on Acesita stock.
- Acesita preferred was down 6.88 percent at 2.30 reais, while its common stock was off 5.56 percent at 2.21 reais in mid-afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
